name: /sdd:generate-specs: plans one spec per phase and asks first

graders.why: it must resolve paths through the Task Workflow section before anything else
the PRD has two phases; it must plan one spec per phase

graders.must_match: (?i)(confirm|shall I|should I|proceed\?|let me know|awaiting|ready to|reply\b|before I (write|create|generate)|say the word|tell me (which|whether|if)|would you (like|prefer)|answer (some|any|these|the)|\bgo ahead\b)
graders.why: the command requires confirmation before writing any files. Matches the act of asking, not a word list: a run that offered lettered options and said "Reply 'go' and I'll write both specs" failed a pattern wanting 'confirm' or 'shall I'
it must not write before confirmation
planning artefacts must land in the spec repo; that path is forbidden
